result.topic_en: The page gives a transformed version of a formula (III) for a quantity G involving trigonometric functions of λnt, and deduces from it trigonometric series identities that Gauss calls remarkable.
result.transcription:
Dadurch bekommt die formel II folgende Gestalt
$G = \frac{\mu r a}{\theta(\lambda\lambda-1)}\left\{-\frac{\lambda}{\sin\frac{\pi}{2\lambda}}\cdot\cos\left(nt-\frac{\pi}{2\lambda}\right) + \sin\lambda nt\right\}$ III
Diese formel ist also von $t=0$ bis $t=\frac{\pi}{n\lambda}$ mit I identisch oder

$1+\frac{2}{12\lambda\lambda-3}\cos 2\lambda nt + \frac{2}{240\lambda\lambda-15}\cos 4\lambda nt + \frac{2}{1260\lambda\lambda-35}\cos 6\lambda nt -$

$= \frac{\pi\lambda}{2(\lambda\lambda-1)\sin\frac{\pi}{2\lambda}}\cos\left(nt-\frac{\pi}{2\lambda}\right) - \frac{\pi}{2(\lambda\lambda-1)}\sin\lambda nt$

welches eine merkwürdige Gleichung ist.

Es müßte folglich auch sein

$\frac{\pi}{2\lambda\sin\frac{\pi}{2\lambda}}\cos\left(nt-\frac{\pi}{2\lambda}\right) = 1 - \frac{2}{4\lambda\lambda-1}\cos 2\lambda nt - \frac{2}{16\lambda\lambda-1}\cos 4\lambda nt - \frac{2}{36\lambda\lambda-1}\cos 6\lambda nt$ etc

methods.what: Closed form (formula III) for G as a combination of a phase-shifted cosine and a sine
Fourier cosine series identity equating a series in cos 2kλnt with a closed trigonometric expression, valid on 0 ≤ t ≤ π/(nλ)
Fourier cosine expansion of a phase-shifted cosine in harmonics cos 2kλnt with coefficients 2/(4k²λ²−1)
